差异化私有语言生成Differentially Private Language Generation
和限度内的识别and Identification in the Limit

Anay Mehrotra Grigoris Velegkas Stanford University Google Research anaymehrotra1@gmail.com gvelegkas@google.com Xifan Yu Felix Zhou Yale University Yale University xifan.yu@yale.edu felix.zhou@yale.edu
摘要Abstract

我们发起了极限语言生成的研究，这是最近由We initiate the study of language generation in the limit, a model recently introduced by[KM24a]，在差分隐私的约束下。 我们考虑, under the constraint of differential privacy. We consider the持续释放continual release模型，其中生成器最终必须输出有效字符串流，同时保护整个输入序列的隐私。 我们的第一个主要结果是，对于可数的语言集合，隐私没有任何定性成本：我们提供了model, where a generator must eventually output a stream of valid strings while protecting the privacy of the entire input sequence. Our first main result is that for countable collections of languages, privacy comes at no qualitative cost: we provide anε\varepsilon- 差分私有算法，在限制范围内生成-differentially-private algorithm that generates in the limit from任何any可数集合。 这与许多学习环境形成鲜明对比，在这些环境中，隐私使得学习变得不可能。 然而，隐私确实会带来定量成本：集合的大小是有限的countable collection. This stands in contrast to many learning settings where privacy renders learnability impossible. However, privacy does impose a quantitative cost: there are finite collections of sizekk为此，统一的私人发电需要for which uniform private generation requiresΩ​(k/ε)\Omega(\nicefrac{{k}}{{\varepsilon}})样本，而非私人样本只需一个样本就足够了。samples, whereas just one sample suffices non-privately.

然后我们转向更困难的语言问题We then turn to the harder problem of language识别identification在极限内。 在这里，我们表明隐私会造成根本障碍。 我们证明不in the limit. Here, we show that privacy creates fundamental barriers. We prove that noε\varepsilon-DP算法可以识别包含无限交集和有限集合差的两种语言的集合，这个条件远远强于经典的非私有表征识别。 接下来，我们转向-DP algorithm can identify a collection containing two languages with an infinite intersection and a finite set difference, a condition far stronger than the classical non-private characterization of identification. Next, we turn to the随机的stochastic设置对样本字符串进行 i.i.d 采样的位置。来自分发（而不是由对手生成）。在这里，我们证明当且仅当集合在对抗模型中是可识别的时，私人识别才是可能的。 总之，我们的结果建立了新的维度，在这些维度上，生成和识别有所不同，并且对于识别而言，隐私限制引起的对抗性和随机设置之间的分离。setting where the sample strings are sampled i.i.d. from a distribution (instead of being generated by an adversary). Here, we show that private identification is possible if and only if the collection is identifiable in the adversarial model. Together, our results establish new dimensions along which generation and identification differ and, for identification, a separation between adversarial and stochastic settings induced by privacy constraints.

1 简介Introduction

机器学习系统越来越多地接受敏感数据的训练。 部署后，可以对模型进行查询、共享和重新调整用途，从而公开有关个人训练记录的信息。 这需要经过隐私保证训练的系统，这些保证在恶意对手持有公共信息和下游后处理的情况下仍然有意义。Machine learning systems are increasingly trained on sensitive data. Once deployed, a model can be queried, shared, and repurposed in ways that may expose information about individual training records. This necessitates systems that are trained with privacy guarantees which remain meaningful both in the presence of public information held by a malicious adversary and downstream post-processing.

差分隐私（DP）Differential privacy (DP)[DMNS06a]已成为该要求的标准形式化。 DP 是随机算法的稳定性保证：非正式地，它要求更改训练数据中的单个用户记录不会显着改变输出的分布。 DP 在实践和理论方面都得到了广泛的研究，一个反复出现的主题是隐私与效用的权衡。 例如，在私人 PAC 学习中，纯 DP 已经在长期的工作中进行了研究（参见，has become the standard formalization of this requirement. DP is a stability guarantee for randomized algorithms: informally, it requires that changing a single user record in the training data does not significantly change the distribution over outputs. DP has been studied extensively in both practice and theory, and a recurring theme is a privacy–utility trade-off. For example, in private PAC learning, pure DP has been investigated in a long line of work (see,例如e.g., [BBDS+24a, GGKM21a, BLM20a, ALMM19a, KLNR+11a, FHMS+24a, HMST25a]），揭示了与非隐私环境相比，隐私需要额外样本甚至使学习变得不可能的几种制度。 例如，PAC 学习简单类（例如具有近似 DP 保证的一维阈值）的任务已经不可行), revealing several regimes where privacy requires additional samples or even renders learning impossible compared to the non-private setting. For instance, the task of PAC learning simple classes such as one-dimensional thresholds with approximate DP guarantees is already infeasible[ALMM19a].

最近大型语言模型（LLM）在语言生成方面的成功将这些问题带到了前台。 他们的训练依赖于可能包含敏感数据的庞大文本语料库，并且交互式查询已被证明可以引出记忆的片段The recent success of large language models (LLMs) at language generation has brought these questions to the foreground. Their training relies on vast text corpora that may contain sensitive data, and interactive querying has been shown to elicit memorized fragments[CTWJ+21a]。 这导致人们对训练和调整具有正式隐私保证的语言模型越来越感兴趣，包括 DP 预训练和微调工作（参见，. This has led to growing interest in training and adapting language models with formal privacy guarantees, including DP pretraining and fine-tuning efforts (see,例如e.g., [SMML+25a, ZZME+25a, YNBG+24a, LTLH22a, MRTZ18a]）。 这些发展激发了差异隐私下语言生成的数学研究。). These developments motivate a mathematical study of language generation under differential privacy.

我们在最近的模型中研究这个问题We study this question within the recent model of语言生成的极限language generation in the limit介绍人introduced by[KM24a]。 该模型的动机是经典的学习和识别对抗框架. This model is motivated by classical adversarial frameworks for learning and identification[Gol67a, Lit88a]，但它用生成的目标取代了精确识别的目标——从底层语言生成有效的看不见的字符串。 该过程从对手选择目标语言开始, but it replaces the goal of exact identification with the goal of generation – producing valid unseen strings from the underlying language. The process begins with an adversary selecting a target languageKK来自已知的集合from a known collectionℒ={L1,L2,…}\mathscr{L}=\{L_{1},L_{2},\dots\}并固定一个枚举and fixing an enumeration ofKK.111形式上，枚举Formally, an enumeration ofKK是一个无限序列is an infinite sequencex1,x2,…x_{1},x_{2},\ldots（可能有重复）这样(potentially with duplicates) such thatxi∈Kx_{i}\in K为所有人for allii和每一个and everyx∈Kx\in K出现在某个索引处。appears at some index.每一步At each stepn≥1n\geq 1，对手揭示了, the adversary reveals thenn第-个元素-th elementxnx_{n}的枚举。 观察了这组例子of the enumeration. While identification is impossible for most nontrivial language collections,[KM24a]表明生成的较弱目标在惊人的普遍性上是可行的，包括对于任何可数的语言集合。 这种分离催生了最近一波改进模型及其保证的工作（showed that the weaker objective of generation is feasible in striking generality, including for any countable collection of languages. This separation has catalyzed a wave of recent work refining the model and its guarantees (例如e.g., [LRT25a, KMV25a, CP25a, RR25a]）；看到); seeSection˜1.2。 在这种背景下，我们研究了差异隐私下语言生成的可能性。. Given this context, we investigate the possibility of language generation under differential privacy.

要研究这种情况下的隐私，仅仅保护一个人是不够的。To study privacy in this setting, it is not enough to protect a单身single发电机的输出。 语言的生成是一种持续的互动：在观察之后output of the generator. Language generation is an ongoing interaction: after observingx1:nx_{1:n}发电机输出the generator outputswnw_{n}，并且隐私保证应适用于整个输出记录。 据此，我们采用, and the privacy guarantee should apply to the entire transcript of outputs. Accordingly, we adopt the持续释放continual releaseDP模型model of DP[DNPR10a, CSS11a]，它（非正式地）要求对于在一个时间步长不同的任意两个输入流，, which (informally) requires that for any two input streams that differ at exactly one timestep, the joint distribution of the整个entire输出流最多改变一个乘法因子output stream changes by at most a multiplicative factor ofeεe^{\varepsilon}（对于所需的隐私价值(for desired privacy valueε>0\varepsilon>0）。 这种时间要求严格强于一次性隐私，即使对于简单的任务，已知也会引起随着流的长度而增长的错误). This temporal requirement is strictly stronger than one-shot privacy, and even for simple tasks, it is known to induce error that grows with the length of the stream[JRSS23a, CLNS+24a, ELMZ25a]。 在我们的设置中，由于提前不知道收敛之前的轮数并且流长度是无限的，这一挑战变得更加复杂。 这给我们带来了这项工作中研究的主要问题：. In our setting, this challenge is compounded by the fact that the number of rounds until convergence is not known in advance and the stream length is infinite. This brings us to the main question studied in this work:

我们的贡献主要围绕两条工作线：（1）极限语言生成，（2）持续发布下的差异隐私。 我们总结了最相关的相关工作如下。Our contributions draw on two main lines of work: (1) language generation in the limit, and (2) differential privacy under continual release. We summarize the most relevant related works below.

语言生成受到限制。Language generation in the limit.

持续发布下的差分隐私。Differential privacy under continual release.

3.2 差异化隐私和持续发布Differential Privacy and Continual Release

差异化隐私Differential privacy[DMNS06a]是随机算法的稳定性概念。 直观地说，它通过确保算法的输出不会过于依赖任何单个个人的数据来保护用户的数据。is a stability notion for randomized algorithms. Intuitively, it protects users’ data by ensuring that the output of the algorithm does not depend too strongly on any single individual’s data.

5 结论Conclusion

在这项工作中，我们发起了有限的语言生成和识别中的隐私研究。 令人惊讶的是，在线生成在严格的隐私限制下仍然可以实现，而在线识别则受到严格限制。 与在线设置不同，在随机模型中In this work we initiate the study of privacy in language generation and identification in the limit. Surprisingly, online generation remains achievable under strong privacy constraints, whereas online identification is severely restricted. Unlike the online setting, in the stochastic model of[Ang88a]，所有无需隐私即可识别的集合都可以实现私人识别。 这揭示了私人在线和随机识别之间的强烈分离，这在非私人环境中是不存在的。 我们的工作提出了几个未来的方向： 包括调查差异隐私的更宽松的变体, private identification becomes achievable for all collections which are identifiable without privacy. This reveals a strong separation between private online and stochastic identification, which is absent in non-private settings. Our work suggests several future directions: including investigating more lenient variants of differential privacy[BS16a, Mir17a]，探索隐私与隐私之间的相互作用, exploring the interplay between privacy and广度breadth [KMV25a, KMV26a, CP25a, KW25a, KW26a, PRR25a]，并研究是否可以为不可数集合设计私有算法。, and studying if private algorithms can be designed for uncountable collections.

A.1 语言识别的极限表征Characterization of Language Identification in the Limit

[Ang80a]提供了一个条件，该条件描述了在极限内可识别的可数集合的子集。 非正式地，如果对于任何语言，集合都满足 Angluin 条件provided a condition that characterizes the subset of countable collections which are identifiable in the limit. Informally, a collection satisfies Angluin’s condition if for any languageL∈ℒL\in\mathscr{L}，存在有限子集, there exists a finite subsetTLT_{L}（称为讲述集）作为有限的“指纹”，允许人们区分(called a tell-tale set) that serves as a finite “fingerprint” allowing one to distinguishLL来自包含以下内容的任何其他语言from any other language that containsTLT_{L}.

定义6Definition 6 （安格鲁因的病情(Angluin’s Condition[Ang80a]).

修复语言集合Fix a language collectionℒ={L1,L2,…}\mathscr{L}=\{L_{1},L_{2},\dots\}。 收藏品. The collectionℒ\mathscr{L}据说如果对于任何索引都满足 Angluin 条件is said to satisfy Angluin’s condition if for any indexii，有一个故事，, there is a tell-tale,即i.e.，一组有限的字符串, a finite set of stringsTiT_{i}这样such thatTiT_{i}是一个子集is a subset ofLiL_{i}, 即i.e., Ti⊆LiT_{i}\subseteq L_{i}，并且以下成立：, and the following holds:

对于所有人For allj≥1j\geq 1，如果, ifLj⊇TiL_{j}\supseteq T_{i}，那么, thenLjL_{j}不是真子集is not a proper subset ofLiL_{i}.

粗略地说，这一条件确保在观察足够多的目标语言示例后，可以排除所有不正确的语言。 主要结果为Roughly, this condition ensures that after observing enough examples from the target language, one can rule out all incorrect languages. The main result of[Ang80a]如下：is as follows:

定理A.1Theorem A.1 （极限内识别的表征(Characterization of Identification in the Limit[Ang80a]).

以下内容适用于任何可数语言集合The following holds for any countable collection of languagesℒ.\mathscr{L}.

  1. 1.

    ℒ\mathscr{L}如果它满足 Angluin 条件并且可以访问泄露秘密的预言机，则它在极限范围内是可识别的。is identifiable in the limit if it satisfies Angluin’s condition and one has access to the tell-tale oracle.

  2. 2.

    如果有一个算法可以识别If there is an algorithm that identifiesℒ\mathscr{L}在极限内，那么 Angluin 的条件为真，并且可以实现泄露的预言。in the limit, then Angluin’s condition is true and the tell-tale oracle can be implemented.

上述严格的表征表明，即使对于简单的语言集合（例如所有常规语言的集合），语言识别在信息理论上也是不可能的。 至关重要的是，为了在有限范围内进行识别，访问泄露秘密的预言机是必要的（仅凭它的存在是不够的）；参见定理 2The above tight characterization shows that language identification is information-theoretically impossible even for simple collections of languages, such as the collection of all regular languages. Crucially, access to the tell-tale oracle is necessary for identification in the limit (its existence alone is not sufficient); see Theorem 2 in[Ang80a].

We say thatℐ\mathcal{I} 识别identifiesKK在极限内in the limit如果有时间的话if there is a timen⋆n^{\star}此后它永远不会改变主意，并且其稳定的猜测是正确的：对于所有after which it never changes its mind and its stabilized guess is correct: for alln≥n⋆n\geq n^{\star}我们有we havein=in⋆i_{n}=i_{n^{\star}}和andLin=KL_{i_{n}}=K。 收藏品. The collectionℒ\mathscr{L} is 在极限范围内可识别identifiable in the limit如果存在一个对每个都成功的识别算法if there exists an identification algorithm that succeeds for everyK∈ℒK\in\mathscr{L}以及每个发行版and every distributionDD支持于supported onKK.

备注A.2Remark A.2 （实现随机性识别）(Achieving Identification with Randomness).

戈尔德的极限语言识别模型要求学习者最终稳定在一个正确的索引上Gold’s model of language identification in the limit requires the learner to eventually stabilize on a single correct indexi⋆i^{\star}。 乍一看，这与差分隐私有冲突，因为任何非平凡的 DP 学习者都必须随机化，因此输出一个具有正概率的错误索引。 然而，这是可以解决的：只要保证轮次输出错误索引的概率就足够了. At first glance, this is in tension with differential privacy, since any non-trivial DP learner must randomize and therefore outputs an incorrect index with positive probability. This, however, can be resolved: it suffices to ensure that the probability of outputting an incorrect index at roundnn是可总结的is summable overnn。 Borel-Cantelli 引理意味着，有概率. The Borel–Cantelli lemma then implies that, with probability11，只有有限的错误输出发生，因此学习器稳定在空事件之外的正确索引。, only finitely many incorrect outputs occur, so the learner stabilizes to the correct index outside a null event.

A.3 博雷尔-坎泰利引理Borel–Cantelli Lemma

接下来，我们提出了 Borel 和 Cantelli 的一个众所周知的结果，这对于确保我们的私有算法仅以概率 1 犯有限数量的“错误”很有用。Next, we present a well-known result due to Borel and Cantelli which is useful for ensuring our private algorithms only make a finite number of “mistakes” with probability 1.

引理A.3Lemma A.3 （第一波雷尔-坎泰利引理）(First Borel–Cantelli Lemma).

让Let{ℰ𝓃}n∈ℕ\left\{\euscr{E}_{n}\right\}_{n\in\mathbb{N}}是一系列事件。如果be a sequence of events. If∑n∈ℕPr⁡[ℰ𝓃]<∞,\sum_{n\in\mathbb{N}}\Pr[\euscr{E}_{n}]<\infty,那么无穷多个出现的概率为 0，即then the probability that infinitely many of them occur is 0, that isPr⁡[lim supn→∞ℰ𝓃]=0.\Pr\left[\limsup_{n\rightarrow\infty}\euscr{E}_{n}\right]=0.

A.4 隐私工具Privacy Tools

DP 的一些有用属性包括合成、后处理和群组隐私。Some useful properties of DP include composition, post-processing, and group privacy.

让LetM1:𝒳∗→𝒴,ℳ2:𝒳∗×𝒴→𝒵M_{1}:\euscr{X}^{*}\to\euscr{Y},M_{2}:\euscr{X}^{*}\times\euscr{Y}\to\euscr{Z} be ε1\varepsilon_{1}-DP 和-DP andε2\varepsilon_{2}-DP，分别。 然后是组成-DP, respectively. Then the compositionM2​(⋅,M1​(⋅)):𝒳∗→𝒵M_{2}(\cdot,M_{1}(\cdot)):\euscr{X}^{*}\to\euscr{Z} is (ε1+ε2)(\varepsilon_{1}+\varepsilon_{2})-DP。-DP.

让LetM:𝒳∗→𝒴M:\euscr{X}^{*}\to\euscr{Y} be ε\varepsilon-DP 和-DP andf:𝒴→𝒵f:\euscr{Y}\to\euscr{Z}是任何与数据无关的函数。 然后be any data-independent function. Thenf​(M​(⋅)):𝒳∗→𝒵f(M(\cdot)):\euscr{X}^{*}\to\euscr{Z} is ε\varepsilon-DP。-DP.

让LetM:𝒳∗→𝒴M:\euscr{X}^{*}\to\euscr{Y} be ε\varepsilon-DP。 对于所有数据集-DP. For all datasetsX,X′X,X^{\prime}最多相差that differ by at mostk≥1k\geq 1元素和所有可测量的事件elements, and all measurable eventsℰ⊆Δ​(𝒴)\euscr{E}\subseteq\Delta\left(\euscr{Y}\right),

Pr⁡[M​(X)∈ℰ]≤ℯ𝓀​ε⋅Pr⁡[ℳ​(𝒳′)∈ℰ].\Pr\!\big[M(X)\in\euscr{E}\big]\leq e^{k\varepsilon}\cdot\Pr\!\big[M(X^{\prime})\in\euscr{E}\big]\,.

纯动态规划最普遍的工具之一是指数机制。One of the most ubiquitous tools for pure DP is the exponential mechanism.

定理A.7Theorem A.7 （指数机制；(Exponential Mechanism;[MT07a]).

让LetRR是元素的集合并且be a collection of elements andu:𝒳∗×ℛ→ℝu:\euscr{X}^{*}\times R\to\mathbb{R}具有敏感性的评分函数a score function with sensitivityΔu\Delta_{u}跨相邻数据集。 那么下面的指数机制保留across neighboring datasets. 附录BAppendix B其他相关工作Additional Related Work

下面我们概述一些与极限生成相关的其他工作Below we overview some additional works related to generation in the limit[KM24a]

  • •

    抗噪声能力：Robustness to Noise:虽然模型While the model of[KM24a]假设对手在输入流中没有引入错误或遗漏，最近的工作放宽了这一要求。assumes that the adversary introduces no errors or omissions in the input stream, recent work has relaxed this requirement.[RR25a]允许对手在输入流中引入有限数量的错误，并表明对于所有可数集合来说，有限的生成仍然是可能的。allow the adversary to introduce a finite number of errors in the input stream and show that generation in the limit remains possible for all countable collections.[BPZ26a]允许对手从流中省略目标语言的元素，并且作为推论，表明即使有无限数量的省略，所有可数集合仍然是可生成的。allow the adversary to omit elements of the target language from the stream and, as a corollary, show that all countable collections remain generatable even with an infinite number of omissions.[MVYZ25a]扩展这两个方向，考虑一个模型，其中对手可以引入两种形式的污染（插入“噪音”元素并省略目标语言中的元素），并表明即使有无限量的污染，所有可数集合仍然是可生成的，只要噪音的频率受到“控制”。 我们的私有生成算法建立在以下方法的基础上extend both of these directions, considering a model where the adversary can introduce both forms of contamination (insert “noisy” elements and omit elements from the target language) and show that all countable collections remain generatable even with an infinite amount of contamination, provided the frequency of noise is “controlled.” Our private generation algorithm builds on a method of[MVYZ25a]，有趣的是继承了相同的污染耐受性；特别是，我们的算法既是私有的，又对噪声输入和遗漏具有鲁棒性。, and interestingly inherits the same tolerance to contamination; in particular, our algorithm is both private and robust to noisy inputs and omissions.
